invented.quote: If you have more than 10 people on payroll, I'm not the right fit, and I'll tell you so on the call.
invented.why: The brief states that the bookkeeper does payroll for up to 10 staff, not that salons with more than 10 staff are turned away altogether.

invented.quote: If a month is going to run late, I'll tell you before the 10th, not after.
invented.why: The brief does not mention a policy or commitment to notify clients before the 10th if their books will be late.

invented.quote: On every other day you'll be talking to the person who actually keeps your books.
invented.why: The brief only states that the bookkeeper does not answer the phone on Sundays or Mondays, not that they are available by phone on all other days of the week.
